analysis.summary: The provided document contains unstructured and encoded text fragments from an annual report of Narmada Gelatine. Because the textual content consists mainly of unparseable characters, symbol controls, and raw encoded byte strings, no verifiable management commentary regarding financial guidance, demand outlook, capex, margins, orders, capital allocation, or risks could be extracted. The provided annual report document for Narmada Gelatine consists largely of unreadable character encodings and corrupted text due to PDF extraction artifacts. Consequently, management has not stated any coherent details regarding guidance, demand, capex, margins, orders, capital allocation, or risks. No factual claims or quotes can be reliably extracted from this text.

demand_outlook.claim: India's gelatin market is projected to register a CAGR of 2 to 3% every year in the next few years.
demand_outlook.quote: India's gelatin market is projected to register a CAGR of 2 to 3% every year in the next few years.

margins_costs.claim: Material consumed in fiscal 2023-24 reduced by 1%, driven by better yield.
margins_costs.quote: Material consumed in fiscal 2023-24 reduced by 1%, which is due to better yield, power and fuel cost reduce by 1.5% due to improvement in boiler's efficiency, which resulted in lower consumption of coal and also due to decrease in the coal prices.

margins_costs.claim: Power and fuel costs reduced by 1.5% due to improved boiler efficiency, lower coal consumption, and decreased coal prices.
margins_costs.quote: power and fuel cost reduce by 1.5% due to improvement in boiler's efficiency, which resulted in lower consumption of coal and also due to decrease in the coal prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: The availability and difficulty in sourcing good quality crushed bones as the main raw material is a major issue and a cause of concern.
risks_headwinds.quote: The availability of our main raw material, i.e. crushed bones, is a cause of concern The difficulty in sourcing good quality raw material is a major issue.

risks_headwinds.claim: Low cost industrial or technical grade gelatin unfit for human consumption is being imported from China by unscrupulous traders and sold to capsule manufacturers who blend it with high quality Indian gelatin.
risks_headwinds.quote: According to the minutes of the meeting of the Drugs Consultative Committee – there is an increasing evidence that low cost industrial or technical grade gelatin unfit for human consumption is being imported from China, by unscrupulous traders and sold to capsule manufacturers who blend it with high quality gelatin made in India, in the manufacturing of capsules.

management_commitments.claim: The company entered into a memorandum of understanding with the employees' union for a period of five years.
management_commitments.quote: During the year 2023-24 a memorandum of understanding was reached and signed with the employees' union for a period of five years
